services.name: Xeriscape conversion
services.blurb: Thirsty St. Augustine swapped for native beds, gravel and shade grasses that get by on rain most months.

services.name: Drip irrigation conversion
services.blurb: Spray heads replaced with drip lines that water roots, not sidewalks, on your assigned watering day.

services.name: Irrigation check and repair
services.blurb: Every zone run, every broken head and leak found, and the controller set to the current city rules.

services.name: Native plant beds
services.blurb: Salvia, muhly grass, agave and Texas sage, planted in amended soil above the caliche.

services.name: Limestone patios and paths
services.blurb: Local limestone and flagstone laid on a compacted base, with gaps that let rain soak in.

services.name: Decomposed granite paths
services.blurb: Stabilized granite walks and seating areas that stay put after a hard summer storm.

services.name: Lawn care and mowing
services.blurb: Mowed high for the heat, edged clean, and watered only as much as the lawn really needs.

services.name: Tree and shrub care
services.blurb: Live oaks pruned outside the oak wilt season, shrubs shaped and dead wood cleared from beds.

services.name: Rain catchment and dry creeks
services.blurb: Dry creek beds and rain barrels that slow storm runoff and keep the water on your lot.

services.name: Landscape lighting
services.blurb: Low-voltage path and tree lights on a timer, aimed at plants and steps instead of the neighbors.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: We were watering the front lawn on our one day a week and it still went brown every July. Teresa showed us the numbers for our yard, lawn versus native beds. We kept a small patch of grass for the dog and converted the rest. Our August water bill dropped by about a third.
reviews.name: Ben O.

reviews.text: Their irrigation check found two zones spraying straight onto the driveway and a cracked line under the beds. Fixed in one morning, and the controller is now set to the odd-address day.
reviews.name: Lucia M.

reviews.text: Clear quote with a line for every part of the job, and the range they gave on the phone was close to the final number. The flagstone path is level and the gaps drain fine.
reviews.name: Wyatt H.

reviews.text: Our backyard in Dripping Springs is mostly rock. They broke through the caliche for each plant hole, which nobody else mentioned, and everything they planted in March is still alive after a hundred-degree summer.
reviews.name: Karen J.

reviews.text: Drip conversion on four zones. They labelled each valve box and left a little map in the garage.
reviews.name: Omar F.

reviews.text: Rain used to cut a ditch through our side yard. The dry creek they built looks like it has always been there and the last big storm went right down it, no mud on the patio.
reviews.name: Shelby R.

reviews.text: They asked about our live oaks before anyone touched them and scheduled the pruning for January because of oak wilt. Felt like they actually knew the area.
reviews.name: Graham T.

proof.guarantee: Drip and irrigation work: if a zone we built leaks in the first year, we come back and fix it.
